reason: An MCP server that adds external visual analysis tools for text-only language models, including OCR, image interpretation, UI conversion, diagram and chart analysis, error diagnosis, and image comparison.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 接入商汤视觉模型，为文本模型提供图像分析、OCR、界面转代码、图表理解和双图对比等工具。
summaries.en: An MCP server that connects text-based models to SenseNova visual tools for image analysis, OCR, UI-to-code conversion, chart and diagram understanding, and image comparison.

capabilities: Sends supplied images to the SenseNova API for multimodal analysis
Accepts local file paths, public URLs, and base64 image data
Provides OCR, image analysis, UI-to-artifact generation, error diagnosis, diagram understanding, visualization analysis, and image comparison tools
